camel_example: aliyun dds ModifyTaskInfo --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 't-83br18hlpdrw3uxxxx' --TaskAction modifySwitchTime --StepName exec_task --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Modifies the information of a task in the task center for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 任务操作，修改任务中心的任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-task-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id t-83br18hlpdrw3uxxxx --step-name exec_task --task-action modifySwitchTime --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTaskInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 task IDs
parameters.help_zh: 任务id，多个英文逗号分隔，最多支持10个
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the step visible to the user
parameters.help_zh: 当前用户可见的步骤名
parameters.name: step_name

parameters.help_en: The action name that corresponds to the state described in the actionInfo parameter of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639186.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 操作名，值为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639186.html得到的actionInfo内相应状态对应的操作action名称
parameters.name: task_action

parameters.help_en: A action-related parameter. This parameter can be extended based on your business requirements. This parameter value varies with the value of the TaskAction parameter
parameters.help_zh: 动作相关的参数，根据业务需要扩展，不同的taskAction名需传不同的值
parameters.name: action_params

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code for the failed task. It is the same as that of the ModifyTaskInfo operation
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败错误码，同接口错误码

ErrorTaskId.description_en: The ID of the failed task. The operation returns results after a task fails
ErrorTaskId.description_zh: 失败的任务ID，遇到一个失败即返回
